pages.text: {{hero}} lives by the sea. Each day, {{hero}} swims with a kind shark named Fin. Fin is gray, with a big fin and a sweet smile. Fin likes to play tag in the waves with {{hero}}.
Today, Fin wants to take {{hero}} to see the sea snails at the reef. {{hero}} grabs a mask and swims along with Fin. The sun shines on the waves, and the water is clear.
But a big wave stirs up the sand. {{hero}} can not see the reef, and Fin can not see the snails. The sea is just a gray blur. Which way is the reef?
Fin waits for the sand to sink. Then Fin leads the way, nice and slow. At last, the reef shines in the sun, and {{hero}} sees ten pink snails! {{hero}} and Fin smile.
That night, {{hero}} lies in bed and thinks of Fin. The waves are soft and slow. But on the sill sits a shell that was not there at sunset. Did Fin leave it?
